image_description: A close-up macro shot of a sliced fig. The fruit is cut longitudinally, revealing the internal structure. The exterior skin is green and smooth. The interior flesh transitions from a pale yellow-green near the rind to a deep reddish-brown in the center, filled with numerous small seeds. The background is blurred, showing hints of a patterned surface.

Standard depth-of-field blur, but the transition between the fig edge and the background pattern has slight haloing, typical of AI generation.
